# Slate Cinema

> Slate Cinema is a video production and video editing studio in Brooklyn, New York (132 32nd St, Brooklyn, NY 11232). From concept to campaign, it plans, shoots, edits and distributes cinematic video for brands, and runs social media management for clients.

Slate Cinema is a video production company, not a movie theater. It is based in Brooklyn, shoots across New York City, and works on location nationwide.

Slate Cinema handles the full production pipeline in-house: pre-production (scripts, storyboards, casting, locations, scheduling), production (on-set filming with a full crew), video editing and post-production (editing, color grading, sound design, motion graphics, VFX, AI-assisted workflows), and distribution (platform-native cuts, ad management, social strategy).

## Services

- Video production: commercials, brand films, event recaps, testimonials and social content, shot with a full crew.
- Video editing and post-production: editing, color, sound design, motion graphics and VFX.
- Podcast production: full episodes plus short clips from every episode.
- Social media management: content calendars, posting and reporting across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X.
